fact: On 9 July 2026 the head of the Commercial Registry Authority reviewed the programme to complete the register's modernisation, including electronic linking with banks and public bodies and electronic archiving of company files, and required all branches to work through the electronic system.
title: مصلحة السجل التجاري تتابع مراحل التحول الرقمي للمصلحة مع مديري الفروع بالمناطق
